STILLWATER HERITAGE RECORDS

把旧资料整理清楚

Stillwater Heritage Records 为小型机构整理旧档案。我们负责扫描纸质文件、校对编号、编制检索目录，并核查不同版本的改动。

我们做什么

有的项目只做扫描，有的还要查清一处改动是什么时候加上的。交付时，我们会留下原件出处和核查记录，方便下一位接手。

目前以短期项目和合同岗位为主。是否远程、具体做什么，请看各岗位说明。

01

核对文件清单，确认来源和交付格式。

扫描、命名，再对照原件检查；发现问题就做备注。

交付整理后的文件，同时保留版本和核查记录。

常见问题
需要先上传简历吗？

不用。直接打开样本就能查看，不需要注册或上传简历。

不是。扫描等需要接触原件的工作通常要到现场，请看岗位里的工作方式。

整理档案时遇到看不清的信息怎么办？

STILLWATER HERITAGE RECORDS

Old records, put in order

Stillwater Heritage Records organises old files for small organisations. We scan paper documents, check reference numbers, prepare indexes and review changes between versions.

What we do

Some projects only need scans; others need us to establish when a change was added. We leave source references and checking notes for the next person who takes over.

Most roles are short-term or contract-based. Each listing explains the work and whether it can be done remotely.

SH / RECORDS
01
Receive

Confirm the file list, sources and delivery format.

02
Organise & check

Scan, name and compare with originals. Note any issues.

03
Deliver & archive

Retain versions and checking records for future reference.

Opportunities

Open and closed project roles are listed below.

4 opportunities found.

Contract · Remote · Open

Reservation Records Assistant

Check room numbers, dates and later changes on old hotel bookings.

Arrangement：Remote; arranged per project · 2026-11

Sample case: R-4829

Review sample record →
Role details & company information

Read scans and spreadsheets on a computer, checking booking references, room numbers, registration times and later edits. Leave uncertain entries as they are and add a note. Do not guess.

Look through the sample to see what the checking involves. No registration, CV or personal details are needed.

Short-term · On site · Recruitment closed

Document Scanning Assistant

Scan old documents, check page numbers and prepare the resulting images.

Archived: 2026-10-28

View role description

Check the order of the papers, scan each page and look for missing, crooked or unreadable sections. Name the files using the agreed convention; do not change their contents.

You’ll need patience and attention to detail for page-by-page checks. The project notice gives the location and schedule.

Recruitment for this role has ended.

Part-time · Remote · Recruitment closed

Photo Caption Proofreader

Check filenames, dates and captions for historical photographs.

Archived: 2026-10-22

View role description

Compare captions with the backs of photographs, folder notes and existing indexes. Mark unclear dates or names for checking rather than adding them from memory.

You should be able to use a spreadsheet and keep original filenames and checking notes as instructed.

Recruitment for this role has ended.

Project-based · Remote · Recruitment closed

Archive Index Testing Assistant

Check that electronic records can be found by reference, date and keyword.

Archived: 2026-10-09

View role description

Enter existing archive indexes, check field names and work through a search test checklist. Record the references for duplicate entries or broken links and pass them to the project lead.

Applications are closed. The description is kept here for reference.

Recruitment for this role has ended.

Recruitment updates
2026-11-01

Recruitment is open for the old booking-records project. The sample is now available to view.

2026-10-28

The document scanning project is fully staffed. Applications are closed.

2026-10-22

Recruitment for photo caption proofreading has ended. The description is still available.

Frequently asked questions
Do I need to upload a CV first?

No. You can open the sample without registering or uploading a CV.

Can every role be done remotely?

No. Scanning and other work with physical originals usually require you to be on site. Check the work arrangement in the listing.

What if something in a record is unreadable?

Leave it as it is and mark the part you can’t read. Don’t fill it in from a guess.

Why are closed roles still listed?

We keep descriptions after a project closes so its requirements can still be checked.
